calls.title: Nate and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting covered the confirmation of Google Analytics and Tag Manager access for Nathaniel, who will lead event testing for the Growth Book site. There was a discussion on extending Tag Manager to the authentication and subdomains, pending CEO approval, to ensure accurate conversion tracking. A custom event was deemed necessary for tracking registration success due to the limitations of a single-page application. The team agreed on the need for clear documentation, which Nathaniel will provide immediately. Scheduled follow-ups, including a video update and additional meetings, were established to maintain progress and address questions.
calls.keywords: Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, event tracking, registration conversion, single-page app, custom events
calls.action_items:
**Nathaniel Page**
Send documentation and instructions to Ashley Stirrup on how to implement custom events for registration tracking in Google Tag Manager (06:07)
Record and send a status update video of the week's progress by Thursday (07:51)
Schedule a follow-up meeting or check-in on Monday to address questions or further work (08:13)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Review and discuss with the CEO the possibility of adding Google Tag Manager tags to authentication pages to enable conversion tracking (02:51)
Test the registration and sign-up process to assist in confirming tracking setup and event firing (06:07)
